description: This file contains classes and methods for constructing and manipulating EdgePartition objects within the Spark GraphX library, including builders for creating new edge partitions and reusing existing ones, with internal data structures and sorting mechanisms.

classes.name: EdgePartitionBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing an EdgePartition from scratch, accumulating edges and converting to an EdgePartition.

classes.name: ExistingEdgePartitionBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for creating an EdgePartition from an existing EdgePartition, reusing local vertex IDs.

classes.name: EdgeWithLocalIds
classes.description: Data class representing an edge with associated local source and destination IDs.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new edge to the builder with source, destination, and attribute.

methods.name: toEdgePartition
methods.description: Converts the accumulated edges into an EdgePartition object, performing sorting and indexing.
